description: Land Title Settlement Department - Kalalpitiya, Attanagalla D/S Division, Gampaha District - Cad. Map No. 510600
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications) in various villages within the Gampaha District. The content focuses on land ownership registration, title settlement, and property rights - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
